constraints: seven named worlds: ND Premium Void, Pirate Sea, Atlantis, Gods of the Deep, Sand Sea, Night Sea, Northern Sea
board 10–20% larger than preceding layouts; maximize comfortable mobile cell tapping
piece ranks 1–9 visibly increase in size; rank 9 largest
only active player reserve displayed below board; never opponent reserve
no Back/Reset/Next immediately beneath active pieces; Back in top menu, Reset in menu with confirmation, Next only after game end
Void board may float with an inclined viewpoint, empty warm/cool light opposition, minimalist surround; other boards rest physically on a table/ground
world-specific pieces: Void glass light domes; Pirate leather/brass naval caps; Atlantis stepped temples; Gods of Deep marine beings; Sand Egyptian pyramids; Night Gothic beacons; North runestones
original images can contain generative inconsistencies (e.g. missing numeric glyphs, impossible board occupancy), which must be corrected in functional implementation, not copied as behavior
